name: figma_get_variables
description: Retrieve all Figma Variable collections, modes (e.g. Light/Dark), and design tokens (colors, numbers, strings, booleans) from the active document.

collection_name.description: Optional filter by variable collection name (e.g. 'Theme', 'Tokens', 'Spacing')

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return across all matched collections, to prevent token bloat on large design-token files (default: 300)

target.description: fileName of a specific connected Figma document, when more than one is open (see figma_list_targets).
